text: Visitors have raised concerns about the heavy reliance on AI in the exhibits, with some feeling the experience lacked educational value and was not accessible for taller guests. Several reviews mentioned poor lighting and insufficient signage, which made navigating the library difficult. The timed entry system caused confusion, with advice emerging that arriving later than the scheduled time can reduce wait times. Food service received negative comments regarding quality and wait times. Despite these issues, the overall average rating remains relatively high, and many visitors commented positively on the interactive exhibits and architecture.

Ticket pricing was mentioned a couple of times but did not dominate the feedback.
